open_obligations.what_is_open: For unbounded component size, determine whether root-locus geometry supports an \(f(K)\operatorname{poly}(N)\) decision-and-witness algorithm, or construct a faithful rational W[1]- or W[2]-hardness reduction with budget linear in the source parameter and the corresponding ETH lower bound.
open_obligations.obstruction: The half-tree locus restrictions make realizable root-signature systems substantially narrower than arbitrary minimum-label choice systems. No selector-and-compatibility construction has been certified against every internal root, the rational-square edge constraints, and unintended auxiliary labels; conversely, the locus characterization alone does not bound a dictionary certificate solely as a function of \(K\).
open_obligations.attempted: The available branching invariant was pushed to the exact \(d^K\) algorithm, and the inverse covariance calculation was completed so that any future gadget can be checked without an unproved realization step. Common-center star selectors fail because a cheap common root satisfies all choices, while varying centers create complementary residual labels whose budget is not linear.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Give the unrestricted parameter-preserving classification of whether exactly one root tuple lies in \(\mathcal F_K(\Sigma)\), with complexity matching the eventual feasibility frontier and with at most a constant increase in \(q_\pi\).
open_obligations.obstruction: The feasibility frontier is itself unresolved. The independent ambiguity block transfers nonemptiness to existence of two witnesses, but deliberately duplicates every solution and therefore cannot isolate exactly one solution. A feasibility oracle on unrestricted Gaussian instances has not been shown closed under the root-list restrictions needed by a generic uniqueness self-reduction.
open_obligations.attempted: Forced-root self-reduction was completed for the explicit bounded-choice search, and truncated multiplicity was completed for the ordered dynamic program. The two-vertex faithful block was analyzed at the exact root-tuple level; it supplies a two-witness transfer but not canonical isolation.

open_obligations.what_is_open: Either certify the claimed \((2-\eta)^{q_\pi}\) lower bound under primal-pathwidth SETH on faithful rational Gaussian forests, with exact crossing-label preservation, or exhibit a smaller sufficient state than the live subset and completed-label count.
open_obligations.obstruction: An incidence-pathwidth Set Cover gadget has not been compiled into rational tree signatures without private realization labels crossing a cut or unintended roots discharging obligations cheaply. The inverse-realization equations also force paired directed residual ratios and rational-square constraints, so an abstract set-system lower bound does not transfer by label renaming.
open_obligations.attempted: The full \((K+1)2^{q_\pi}\) right-congruence upper bound was proved, including exact multiplicity. Candidate star and varying-center realizations were checked symbolically; the former admits a universal witness and the latter incurs complementary labels. No collision-free Gaussian compatibility gadget or smaller exact state emerged.
